description: This file appears to be a Markdown documentation file describing the class `JSHandle` in a software project, likely related to a JavaScript or web automation framework. It details methods, usage examples in multiple languages, and internal concepts related to `JSHandle` objects used for interacting with JavaScript objects within a page context.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Represents an in-page JavaScript object handle, used for interacting with JavaScript objects within a page context, including methods for evaluating scripts, accessing properties, and disposal.

methods.name: JSHandle.asElement
methods.description: Returns either `null` or the object handle itself if the handle is an instance of ElementHandle.

methods.name: JSHandle.dispose
methods.description: Stops referencing the object handle, disposing of the handle.

methods.name: JSHandle.evaluate
methods.description: Returns the value of the given expression evaluated in the context of the object handle.

methods.name: JSHandle.evaluateHandle
methods.description: Returns the result of the evaluated expression as a JSHandle.

methods.name: JSHandle.getProperties
methods.description: Returns a map of the object's own property names to JSHandle instances.

methods.name: JSHandle.getProperty
methods.description: Fetches a single property from the referenced object as a JSHandle.

methods.name: JSHandle.jsonValue
methods.description: Returns a JSON-serializable representation of the referenced object.
